title: Devitt betrays Apollo 55 & creates Bullet Club
summary: Prince Devitt breaks with Ryusuke Taguchi and gathers allies around a more ruthless ambition. The formation of Bullet Club turns a tag-team breakup into a promotion-wide threat.

chapters.title: Apollo 55 breaks apart
chapters.result: Devitt turns on Taguchi and aligns with Bad Luck Fale.
chapters.context: The betrayed partner becomes the personal enemy left behind as Devitt pursues a new identity.

chapters.title: The founding alliance forms
chapters.result: Devitt, Fale, Anderson and Tonga unite against Tanahashi.
chapters.context: The four men establish the alliance that becomes Bullet Club, using collective attacks to challenge the existing hierarchy.

chapters.title: Taguchi gets his singles payoff
chapters.result: Taguchi defeats Devitt after Devitt rejects the Young Bucks’ interference.
chapters.context: Devitt’s confrontation with his former partner ends with a handshake and his departure from this faction chapter.
